stem: Per Rule 090101, what is a defining feature of a 'virtual meeting/engagement' under the PSR?

options.A: It requires prior written approval from the Federal Civil Service Commission for every instance
options.B: It can only take place using a Government-issued laptop
options.C: Officers communicate effectively via pre-scheduled teleconference, web conference, or video conference, regardless of physical location
options.D: It must always involve at least 10 participants from different MDAs

explanation: Rule 090101: virtual meetings/engagements occur when Officers communicate effectively during pre-scheduled teleconferences, web conferences, or video conferences, irrespective of physical location.

stem: Per Rule 090102, what is the main rationale for implementing virtual meetings/engagements in the Public Service?

options.B: To replace in-person meetings permanently in all circumstances
options.C: To ensure employees can respond to work demands remotely, keeping MDAs functioning with minimal disruption during a pandemic/emergency
options.D: To cut travel allowance costs as the primary objective

explanation: Rule 090102: implementation is to ensure employees respond to work demands remotely, so MDAs continue functioning adequately with minimal disruption during a pandemic/emergency.
